title: Doctor Call Notes
description: WERT-specific Doctor Call Notes report based on legacy rptDoctorCallNotes.php. Shows call notes by doctor/date within the user's territory scope. Disabled after correction: Tagging Verification is the intended report entry.

source.sql: select top 5000 ltrim(rtrim(cast(cn.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id, ltrim(rtrim(cast(cn.MD_ID as varchar(128)))) as md_id, cn.[DATE] as note_date, replace(convert(varchar(max), cn.NOTES), 'ÂyesÂ / ÂnoÂ', 'yes/no') as notes from [dbo].[call_notes] cn where cn.MD_ID is not null and ltrim(rtrim(cast(cn.MD_ID as varchar(128)))) <> 'UNK' and cn.[DATE] >= @startDate and cn.[DATE] < dateadd(day, 1, @endDate) and (@mdId is null or @mdId = '' or ltrim(rtrim(cast(cn.MD_ID as varchar(128)))) = @mdId) {{territoryPredicate:cn.TERRITORY_ID}} order by cn.[DATE] desc, cn.TERRITORY_ID, cn.MD_ID

dataSourceDefinition.notes: Legacy rptDoctorCallNotes.php was a popup filtered by md_id and exact date from WERT tagging/detail reports. Modern version keeps the same call_notes source but exposes a constrained WERT-only report with required date range and optional MD ID. WERT stores NOTES as b64-prefixed UTF-32BE in some rows; the report API decodes those values for display.
